Round() Function:
```{r}
pi = 3.14159
pi_rounded = round(pi)
print(pi_rounded)
```
Round() Function Continued:

```{r}
pi = 3.14159
pi_rounded_2dp = round(pi, digits = 2)
print(pi_rounded_2dp)
```
Rep() Function:

```{r}
rep(5, 10)
#or
print(rep(x=5, times=10))
```
Character, Numerical, and Logical Variables:

```{r}
char = "hello!"
num = 220
log = TRUE

print(char)
print(class(char))

print(num)
print(class(num))

print(log)
print(class(log))
```
Using Variables of Different Types:
```{r}
cell_ID_1 = "CX1"
cell_ID_2 = "CX2"
treated_1 = TRUE
treated_2 = FALSE
num_cells_before_1 = 5415
```
